note: Shared between the TypeScript action (src/conventional.ts) and tests/test_infra_github.py, which pins this repository's PR-title gate to the same list. One copy, read by both languages, because both fail quietly when they drift: too strict red-lights a title that would have released correctly, too loose lets a commit onto master that the changelog silently omits.
source: The default `types` of conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits, which is what release-please writes notes with while this repository sets no `changelog-sections`.
